entities.name: Measurement identity addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure for adding or modifying measurement identities in UE configuration. The network configures measId only if corresponding measurement object, reporting configuration, and quantity configuration are configured.

entities.name: Measurement identity
entities.description: Identifier that links a measurement object with a reporting configuration and quantity configuration.

entities.name: Measurement identity to add/modify list
entities.description: List containing measurement identities to be added or modified in UE configuration.

entities.name: Variable measurement configuration
entities.description: UE's stored measurement configuration containing the measIdList.

entities.name: Timer T321
entities.description: Timer used for measurement reporting with reportCGI, with values ranging from 200 ms to 16 seconds depending on frequency range and autonomous gaps configuration.

entities.name: Timer T322
entities.description: Timer used for SFTD measurement reporting, with values of 3 seconds for FR1 and 24 seconds for FR2.

entities.name: Report type is reportCGI
entities.description: Condition where the reportType is set to reportCGI in the reporting configuration.

entities.name: Report type is reportSFTD with DRX
entities.description: Condition where reportType is set to reportSFTD and drx-SFTD-NeighMeas is included.

entities.name: Use autonomous gaps included
entities.description: Condition where useAutonomousGaps is included in the reporting configuration.

entities.name: Measurement object concerns E-UTRA
entities.description: Condition where the measurement object associated with measId concerns E-UTRA.

entities.name: Measurement object concerns NR FR1
entities.description: Condition where the measurement object associated with measId concerns NR FR1.

entities.name: Measurement object concerns NR FR2
entities.description: Condition where the measurement object associated with measId concerns NR FR2.

relations.description: The procedure operates on the measurement identity to add/modify list.
The procedure modifies the variable measurement configuration by adding or replacing entries in measIdList.
The procedure removes measurement reporting entries from the variable measurement report list.
The procedure starts timer T321 under specific conditions for reportCGI.
The procedure starts timer T322 under specific conditions for reportSFTD.
Timer T321 is started when reportType is set to reportCGI.
Timer T322 is started when reportType is set to reportSFTD and drx-SFTD-NeighMeas is included.
The value of timer T321 depends on whether useAutonomousGaps is included.
Timer T321 value depends on whether measurement object concerns E-UTRA.
Timer T321 value depends on whether measurement object concerns NR FR1.
Timer T321 value depends on whether measurement object concerns NR FR2.
Timer T322 value is 3 seconds when measurement object concerns NR FR1.
Timer T322 value is 24 seconds when measurement object concerns NR FR2.
